b.request: For processing records whose site code matches a site, group by site code and insurance status; report each group’s average nonmissing remaining storage, average nonmissing absolute CPU–GPU usage difference, and average remaining storage divided by the mean of all groups’ nonmissing average remaining storage values. Return no rows if that overall mean is missing; otherwise, return the top 10 groups sorted by the ratio descending, with missing ratios last and no rounding
b.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT p.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(p.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(p.proccpu - p.procgpu)) AS avg_absolute_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS p JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = p.zoneref GROUP BY p.zoneref, s.insurstat), with_mean AS (SELECT site_groups.*, AVG(avg_remaining_storage) OVER () AS overall_mean FROM site_groups) SELECT site_code, insurance_status, avg_remaining_storage, avg_absolute_cpu_gpu_difference, avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(overall_mean, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM with_mean WHERE overall_mean IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

a.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average absolute difference between CPU usage and GPU usage (|`proccpu` − `procgpu`|, regardless of which is larger), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows.
a.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_gpu_difference, g.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(o.mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

c.request: Using only processing records whose site code (`scanprocessing.zoneref`) matches a site in `sites`, group by that site code and the site's insurance status (`sites.insurstat`). For each group, show the site code, the insurance status, the average remaining storage (`remaingb`), the average CPU–GPU usage gap (`proccpu`, `procgpu`), and the ratio of the group's average remaining storage to the mean of all groups' average remaining storage values (ignoring missing ones; return no rows if that mean is missing). Ignore missing values in all averages and don't round anything. Sort by that ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return only the top 10 rows. The usage gap is the size of the difference, whichever of CPU or GPU is larger.
c.sql: WITH site_averages AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_gap FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM site_averages) SELECT sa.site_code, sa.insurance_status, sa.avg_remaining_storage, sa.avg_cpu_gpu_gap, sa.avg_remaining_storage / NULLIF(om.mean_group_storage, 0) AS storage_ratio FROM site_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS om WHERE om.mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

Ignore missing values in all averages, return no rows if that overall mean is missing, and do not round. Sort by the ratio from highest to lowest with missing ratios last, and return the top 10 rows.
d.sql: WITH site_groups AS (SELECT sp.zoneref AS site_code, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, AVG(sp.remaingb) AS avg_remaining_storage, AVG(ABS(sp.proccpu - sp.procgpu)) AS avg_cpu_gpu_difference FROM scanprocessing AS sp JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sp.zoneref GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.insurstat), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining_storage) AS mean_group_storage FROM site_groups) SELECT g.site_code, g.insurance_status, g.avg_remaining_storage, g.avg_cpu_gpu_difference, g.avg_remaining_storage / o.mean_group_storage AS storage_ratio FROM site_groups AS g CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.mean_group_storage IS NOT NULL ORDER BY storage_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
